# UR: Synthetic saved-filter need

## Problem
Operators repeatedly recreate the same filter.

## Goal
An operator can save and restore one named filter.

## Scope
One user-owned saved filter, no sharing.

## Non-Goals
No shared filters or permissions change.

## AGDF Approval Summary (de; source=en)
- Problem: Derselbe Filter muss wiederholt aufgebaut werden.
- Ziel: Einen benannten persönlichen Filter speichern und wiederherstellen.
- Umfang: Ein Filter ohne Teilen oder Berechtigungsänderung.

presentation_format.source: source-authored canonical artefact or validated localized AGDF Approval Summary; no adapter paraphrase
presentation_format.missing_fields: retain absence and the complete validated summary; do not fabricate a legacy brief
presentation_format.delivery: native_plus_chat only with qualified native approval and confirmed display on the current user surface; otherwise full_chat; forward one exact decision request. Mac display never proves iPad visibility.
presentation_format.remote_document: presentation-document; exact binding and every cursor; local file links do not prove iPad access
presentation_format.remote_preview: presentation-preview; exact binding and every cursor; render only through isolated supported access; unavailable access leaves the review open

report.confirmation_boundary: host permission, concrete human intent and Core eligibility are separate

operation.description: Read-only operation; requirements below. Reads never prepare or approve a gate.

presentation_language.description: Required BCP47 tag; valid unsupported languages use the complete English pack.

working_directory.description: Absolute execution context; it does not select a target.

target_source.description: explicit_target: directly specified target; continued_target: confirmed continuation; current_repository: unambiguous current repository. Use actual provenance.

primary_target.description: Confirmed absolute project root, paired with target_source. working_directory never selects the target.

run_id.description: Use the named or unambiguously confirmed run; never select by recency.

gate.description: Use the requested document gate; it is an optional catalog filter, not a selection heuristic. artifact-readiness accepts UR, PRD, SD or TP drafts only.

expected_revision_id.description: For bound current-state inspections use the current gate-check revision. For document/preview reads preserve the selected prepared record original revision from catalog read_arguments or the original conversation binding.

presentation_id.description: Use the exact prepared ID from a validated catalog candidate or the existing conversation binding. Never guess a UUID, choose by timestamp, or prepare another presentation to pass a read.

target_id.description: Copy binding.target_id from operation-contract or the selected catalog read_arguments; this digest identifies a target and grants no authority.

cursor.description: Omit on the first page, then copy next_cursor unchanged. Catalog cursors are accepted only on operation-contract module=agdf_prepare/presentation.prepare. Never exchange document, preview or catalog cursors.

variant.description: gate-check only: status-card or approval-envelope. Neither variant records an approval.

module.description: contract uses an advertised runtime module; operation-contract uses group/kind; operation-status uses the original operation_id from the saved command receipt, never a newly generated UUID.

all_active.description: Only doctor and delivery-map accept true. False retains the selected-run read behavior.

inspect_contract.provenance: Keep exact conversation bindings. Otherwise use catalog read_arguments only after unique complete discovery or explicit selection. Document revision is original, not current. Prepared is not human-viewed or approved. Other modules reject catalog cursors.

presentation_catalog.next_action: Use exact read_arguments; follow every document next_cursor.
